The 1.21.10 tree has the gate: game/creatures.rs:7442-7450 spawn_egg_allowed plus the use_failed return at :7462-7465, with FAIL semantics (use_failed means the action is not consumed, game/lan_actions.rs:2536-2539). items.evidence: Vanilla 1.21.10 has NO block_transformer registry or component: the axe/hoe/shovel tables live in AxeItem/HoeItem/ShovelItem (STRIPPABLES/TILLABLES/FLATTENABLES; 0 BlockTransformer references in any dump) and the jar's datapack carries 0 block_transformer data files. The 1.21.10 port keeps the 26.2/26.3 form: game.rs block_transform reads the minecraft:block_transformer component from items.json (0/1,488 items carry it; horizon-items/src/items.rs:976) and returns None for every tool (game.rs:7955-7959), and block_transform.rs Transformers::load reads data/minecraft/block_transformer/*.json (0 files in the prepared data), so the transform table is empty. Axe strip/scrape/wax-off, hoe till, shovel flatten AND honeycomb wax-on (block_transform.rs:245 waxed() reads the empty axe table; callers game.rs:8346, game/remote.rs:8797) are all entirely non-functional. No horizon-prepare synthesis step exists for the registry. REPRODUCES from 1.21.7 and 26.1.2; re-checked first.
items.title: Axe/hoe/shovel transforms and honeycomb wax-on entirely non-functional (26.2/26.3 block_transformer form)

items.evidence: Vanilla 1.21.10 ShovelItem.useOn dowses a lit campfire directly (face != DOWN, CampfireBlock.dowse + level event 1009, ShovelItem.txt:64-88); there is no #douses_campfires tag in 1.21.10 (absent from ItemTags, the client jar's datapack - 190 item tag files - and the prepared item tags - 172 files, no douses_campfires.json). The 1.21.10 port keeps the 26.3 form: game/campfire_douse.rs:12-17 gates the douse on #minecraft:douses_campfires (CampfireBlock.useItemOn), so campfire_to_douse always returns None and a shovel never puts out a campfire; the face != DOWN check was also dropped. REPRODUCES from 1.21.7 and 26.1.2; re-checked first.
items.title: Shovel campfire douse dead: gated on the absent #douses_campfires tag

items.evidence: Vanilla 1.21.10 LivingEntity.randomTeleport is blocksMotion-grounded (4-arg signature (DDDZ), no tag parameter, javap-verified fresh, LivingEntity.txt:9299). The Rust game/consume.rs:120-139 walks down for #minecraft:entities_can_teleport_to, a tag absent in 1.21.10 (absent from BlockTags, the client jar's datapack and prepared block-tags.json, 203 tags), so the loop always runs to min_y and returns false - chorus fruit never teleports. REPRODUCES from 1.21.7 and 26.1.2. Note: the tree also keeps a level-event 2017 directional-particle trail on the consume path (horizon-world/src/teleport_consume.rs apply + game/consume.rs:422-431 directional_particles; vanilla TeleportRandomlyConsumeEffect has only a diameter field and emits no level event, javap-verified fresh), but it is masked by this defect - the trail fires only after a successful teleport, which never happens; fixing G09 without removing the trail would expose it.
items.title: Chorus fruit never teleports (tag #entities_can_teleport_to absent in 1.21.10)

items.evidence: Vanilla 1.21.10 AbstractThrownPotion has ZERO PotionTags references - it gates on PotionContents.is(Potions.WATER) directly (javap-verified fresh; the 1.21.10 jar has no PotionTags class at all and no data/minecraft/tags/potion/). method: Static analysis only - javap -c -p on the named 1.21.10 jars (client-named.jar for client classes, server-game-named.jar for server classes) for every vanilla method in scope, Rust source reads, prepared-data checks (the 1.21.10 tree's .local items.json, block-tags.json, jar data files), and a diff of every in-scope oracle source between the 26.1.2 and 1.21.10 trees (20/30 byte-identical; 10 differ only by the Identifier->ResourceLocation 1.21.x adaptation). Jar sha1s verified against the brief pins before use. NO drivers were run and NO oracle repairs were done: this batch is checks + triage only per the brief (no cargo builds, no driver runs). The 33 runnable drivers and 17 no-oracle drivers are recorded as not run, not as passes. Driver inventory: 74 drivers - 33 runnable-but-unrun, 24 blocked on 25 measured-failing oracles (PROVISIONAL: the 1.21.10 Batch 0 table has not landed, so statuses derive from the 26.1.2 table plus the verified B7-O11 fix), 17 no-oracle. Oracle sets cross-checked against the 1.21.10 driver files; the only mismatch is interaction_input (also references the ParityData helper). Fixed in the 1.21.10 tree: B7-G01 (ComponentMap::set now returns Ok(base) on a dangling removal marker), B7-G04 (the peaceful gate - vanilla 1.21.10 HAS it and the port HAS it), B7-G13/G14/G15 (masked - the code is still wrong but unreachable because no transform ever succeeds), B7-G16 (stays fixed), B7-O11 (KnockbackClient adapted to ServerboundSwingPacket). Withdrawn for 1.21.10 (re-checked against 1.21.10's jar + tree): B7-G02 (1.21.10's BucketItem HAS the sneak check), B7-G05 (1.21.10 posts ENTITY_PLACE at the spawn position).

source: docs/PARITY-SWEEP.md §4 Batch 7 - checks + triage only, no fixes. Scope: item use, food, tools, armour, buckets, spawn eggs, components - 1,488 items. The item->Java-class map was extracted fresh from the named 1.21.10 jar: all 1,488 items mapped to 70 classes, 0 unmapped, 0 mismatches against block-behaviours.json (parser fixed for the WeatheringCopperItems collections - see the report §1). No spears and no nautilus armour exist in 1.21.10 (26.x-only items), so B33/B34 cover the 1.21.10 families instead (copper golem spawn egg, ominous bottle / trial key). The four re-check-first regressions in this batch's scope (B7-G07 tool transforms, B7-G08 campfire douse, B7-G09 chorus fruit, B7-G10 splash water) were re-checked first and all four REPRODUCE. No new behaviour defect was found in scope.
systemic_note: The 1.21.10 Items tree is a fresh full port of the 1.21.11 era template, not a 26.x re-port - and it fixed two things the 26.x trees never did: B7-G01 (ComponentMap::set now returns Ok(base) on a dangling removal marker, with a doc comment citing 1.21.10's vanilla form) and B7-O11 (KnockbackClient adapted to ServerboundSwingPacket). But the four re-check-first regressions (G07 block_transformer registry/component instead of hardcoded tables: axe/hoe/shovel/honeycomb all dead; G08 #douses_campfires tag instead of the direct shovel douse; G09 #entities_can_teleport_to tag instead of blocksMotion grounding; G10 potion-tag gate instead of the direct Potions.WATER check) reproduce verbatim, as do G03, G06, G11, G12, G17, G18, G19. Vanilla changed between 1.21.7 and 1.21.10 in exactly the two places that withdraw 1.21.7 items: the bucket sneak check and the spawn-egg peaceful gate + spawn-position ENTITY_PLACE all exist in 1.21.10's jar where 1.21.7 had none of them. The absent-tag root cause is unchanged in scope (#douses_campfires, #entities_can_teleport_to in four places, #enderman_does_not_teleport_to, #consumable_does_not_teleport_to, the minecraft:block_transformer and minecraft:mob_visibility components), and the tag table resolves absent tags to empty sets, so every read silently degrades to false, never an error. Three of this batch's reproductions are suspected duplicates of other 1.21.10 batches (B1-G03, B5-G19, B3-G39) and are flagged as such for the coordinator to fold once those reports land; the hoglin peaceful-list residual is Batch 3's B3-G04 facet. This run also corrects the record: the 1.21.7 item->class parser mis-attributes the WeatheringCopperItems collections in 1.21.10 (24 unmapped, 26 mismatches before the fix); the 26.1.2 data-check script's mob-bucket food assumption does not hold for 1.21.10 (vanilla puts no food component on mob buckets); and vanilla 1.21.10 has no named SpawnEggItemBehavior class (the dispenser spawn-egg behaviour is the anonymous DispenseItemBehavior$1).
